## Scope

- Describe the user-visible or experimental behavior changed by this pull request.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests cover the behavior and its failure path.
- [ ] The owning user, maintainer, or experiment documentation is updated.
- [ ] Any new or changed decision-relevant number is classified in
      `software_agent_team.decision_limits`, points to its single value owner, and
      states visibility, configurability, trigger consequence, recovery, and
      required revision evidence.
- [ ] Product defaults do not introduce Agent, call, token, Reviewer, iteration,
      cumulative Agent-duration, or per-invocation wall-clock ceilings.
